verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that Adyen-generated reports exist for bookkeeping and reconciliation, which suggests some transaction data can be taken out of the platform. Nothing documents the report formats, a complete export, or a path for leaving. missing for 10: documented full-account data export, explicit open formats (e.g. CSV/JSON), export of legal-entity/balance/payout data, offboarding or data-portability guidance, independent corroboration.
